messages.content:
Risk: Obscene/Abusive Content
Description: The AI system may generate or disseminate content that is obscene, degrading, or sexually abusive, including child sexual abuse material (CSAM) or non-consensual intimate images (NCII).
Concern: None
Policy: Sexually Explicit

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PornographicContentDescription: Pornographic Content Description — Descriptions or generation of explicit sexual material intended for sexual arousal, mimicking pornographic media formats. [found by 9/13 queries]
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Explicit Sexual Description, Reproductive Health Boundary
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors. [found by 8/13 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 8/13 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NonConsensualIntimateImagery: Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery — Creation, distribution, or threat of distributing sexually explicit images or videos without the depicted individual's consent. [found by 6/13 queries]
  Siblings: Child Sexual Exploitation, Sexual Exploitation Harassment, Sexual Coercion
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualExploitation: Sexual Exploitation — Abuse of a position of vulnerability, power differential, or trust for sexual purposes, including trafficking, assault, non-consensual imagery, and exploitation of minors. [found by 5/13 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property

axes.rationale: This class directly addresses the risk of generating content with sexual themes, which is central to the 'Obscene/Abusive Content' risk.
The risk explicitly mentions NCII, making this class highly relevant. It captures a specific and concerning type of abusive content.
